methods.node_jaccard: intersection / union of selected real Entrez node sets
methods.evidence_node_jaccard: same, restricted to nodes with model SHAP evidence in each seed
methods.backbone_edge_jaccard: intersection / union of canonical undirected selected_forest_edges; induced PPI edges excluded
methods.seed_medoid: highest mean node Jaccard to the other nine seeds; ties broken by ascending seed
connectivity_comparisons: union of seed backbones restricted to the node set
frozen number>=2 PPI induced on the node set

software: Python 3.7.9, standard library plus installed NumPy for verifying saved solver arrays
